title: Marine HR Executive (Planning)
description:
Behind every well-crewed vessel is a team that plans, coordinates, and keeps things running seamlessly from shore. As an Executive in the EPS Marine HR Planning team, you will play a central role in managing the manpower pipeline for our fleet, from forecasting crew requirements and coordinating with manning offices worldwide to supporting crew evaluations and handling day to day HR matters for ship staff. If you enjoy working in a fast paced, people focused environment where your decisions have a real and direct impact on vessel operations, this is a position worth considering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and forecast manpower requirements in coordination with the Manager and Assistant Manager, Marine HR.
* Plan, source, and coordinate the recruitment of ship staff to meet fleet manning requirements, including processing applications for assigned ranks.
* Coordinate with EPS-appointed manning offices worldwide to ensure compliance with company policies, STCW 95 requirements, and crew qualification standards.
* Handle crew-related HR matters including crew evaluations, promotions, counselling, and NTBR cases.
* Monitor seafarer readiness with manning offices, manage unassigned ship staff, and finalise crew assignments in COMPAS.
* Ensure crew changes are carried out in a timely, cost-effective, and respectful manner.
* Follow up on LLP and pension requests for assigned ranks, coordinating with Manning offices and Crew Accounts for approvals and remittances.
* Review seniority data, identify manpower gaps, and prepare gap analysis and monthly reports as required.
* Provide timely responses to vessel queries and liaise with the Marine HR Manager on exceptions highlighted from crew evaluations.
* Calculate wages for take-over vessels and ensure Matrix compliance assignments are completed for the Tanker Fleet.

**Requirements**

* More than 3 to 4 years of working experience in a Marine HR portfolio (preferred).
* Good knowledge of STCW, MLC 2006, and related maritime regulations.
* Familiarity with crew management systems and payroll processes.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to work across a multinational and professional environment.
* Proficient in MS Office applications, including MS Word and Excel.

At EPS, we know that a strong shore team is the backbone of a well-run fleet. We are committed to being an industry-leading ship management company, and we invest in people who are passionate about the maritime industry. EPS is equally committed to minimizing the environmental impact of its business, having achieved the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Standard. If you are looking to build a meaningful and long-term career in Marine HR, we would be glad to hear from you.

Personal data collected from applications will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Notice: We do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any associated fees for unsolicited submissions. We also do not require job applicants to pay a fee as part of the recruitment process.

*With a history spanning 60 years, Eastern Pacific Shipping is a leading shipping company that is committed to the green and technology-driven growth of the industry. Headquartered in Singapore for the past 30 years, EPS is driven by its mission to be the safe and efficient transportation provider of choice to the shipping industry. Empowering that mission are 8,000 skilled and dedicated sea and shore staff that oversee a versatile fleet of 34 million deadweight-tonnes across four core segments of containership, dry bulk, gas, and tanker vessels. EPS's shore team is fully integrated with in-house commercial, finance, innovation, IT, legal, manning, operations, and technical departments.*

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
We're Hiring: Executive – HR & Administration

Alvita Pharma Pvt. Ltd. | Corporate Office, Borivali West, Mumbai

Experience: 3–4 years | Full-time

Alvita Pharma Pvt. Ltd. is a globally trusted pharmaceutical merchant exporter, supplying quality-assured products to over 35 countries in partnership with EU-GMP, US-FDA, WHO-GMP and PIC/S certified manufacturers.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a driven and detail-oriented HR & Admin Executive to take end-to-end ownership of our Human Resources and Administration functions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Talent Acquisition: Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, including manpower planning, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and campus/institutional hiring partnerships.

- Onboarding: Ensure a structured and seamless onboarding and induction experience for new joiners.

- Payroll & Attendance: Process monthly payroll accurately and on time through Keka HRMS, including attendance, leave and regularization management.

- Statutory Compliance: Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, Bonus, etc.) and uphold internal HR policies.

- HR Documentation: Maintain employee records and documentation, including offer letters, appointment letters, confirmations and exit formalities.

- HR MIS & Reporting: Prepare monthly HR MIS reports covering headcount, attrition, recruitment status and other key metrics.

- Performance Management: Administer the PMS, including KRA/KPI setting, appraisal cycles and performance reviews.

- Training & Development: Identify training needs, plan learning interventions and track their effectiveness.

- Employee Engagement: Design and execute engagement and welfare initiatives, address grievances and foster a positive, high-performance culture.

- Office & Facility Administration: Oversee housekeeping, security, pantry, upkeep, travel bookings and courier/logistics coordination.

- Vendor Management: Manage admin vendors, track AMCs, process bills and monitor expenses against budget.

- Asset & Inventory Management: Maintain records of company assets and office supplies, including allocation at joining and recovery at exit.

DESIRED PROFILE

- PGDM / MBA / PGCHR with specialization in Human Resources

- 3–4 years of relevant experience in a generalist HR & Administration role

- Sound working knowledge of payroll processing and Indian labour law compliance

- Proficiency in MS Excel for MIS reporting; experience with Keka HRMS is an advantage

- Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills

- Strong process orientation, integrity and the ability to handle confidential information

WHY JOIN US

Be part of a growing, globally connected pharmaceutical organization where you will take real ownership of the HR and Administration functions and help shape our people practices and culture.

We encourage applications from women professionals and candidates from diverse backgrounds.

HOW TO APPLY:

Interested candidates may share their updated CV at vinayjayaram@alvitapharma.co.in with the subject line "Application – HR & Admin Executive".

Referrals are welcome.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Head of Human Resources**

**About the Role**

Nextyn is looking for a Head of Human Resources to lead our people function and shape how we attract, develop, and retain talent as we grow. This is a senior leadership seat. You will report directly to the
**CEO**
and sit at the leadership table, contributing to company-wide strategic decisions, including new market entry, where people capability is a core part of the business case. You will set the people strategy, build a high-performing HR team, and make sure Nextyn’s culture and values carry through every stage of the employee lifecycle. You will work closely with the leadership team and act as a trusted partner to managers and employees at all levels.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Leadership & Strategic Decision-Making***

* Serve as a member of the senior leadership team, contributing to company strategy and major business decisions.
* Assess the people implications of strategic choices, including new market entry, expansion, restructuring, and M&A, covering talent availability, organizational design, cultural fit, and workforce cost.
* Partner with the CEO and leadership team to translate business goals into workforce plans and capability-building roadmaps.
* Define and lead the People & Culture strategy in line with Nextyn’s business goals and growth plans.
* Build, mentor, and manage the People & Culture team, setting clear goals and high standards of performance.
* Advise the leadership team on organizational design, workforce planning, and talent decisions.

***Talent Acquisition***

* Own the hiring strategy and recruitment roadmap across departments.
* Plan and execute local and cross-market hiring for new markets, including leadership hires and in-market talent sourcing.
* Partner with hiring managers to define workforce needs, hiring plans, and candidate profiles.
* Build a strong employer brand and a consistently positive candidate experience.

***Employee Lifecycle & Development***

* Oversee onboarding, orientation, and early-tenure engagement for new hires.
* Design and drive learning and development programs, career pathways, and succession planning.
* Lead performance management processes, including goal setting, reviews, and calibration.

***Culture & Engagement***

* Design and lead employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and feedback mechanisms.
* Translate Nextyn’s values into everyday practices and recognition programs.
* Identify engagement risks early and act on them with managers and leadership.
* Maintain and evolve Nextyn’s culture as the organization expands into new teams and markets.

***HR Operations, Policy & Compliance***

* Oversee HR operations, including payroll coordination, attendance, leave, and benefits administration.
* Develop, review, and update HR policies to ensure alignment with applicable labor laws and statutory requirements, including those of any new market.
* Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and effective use of the HRMS (KEKA) across the organization.
* Use people data and analytics to inform decisions on attrition, engagement, productivity, compensation, and market expansion.

***Employee Relations***

* Serve as the escalation point for complex employee relations matters, handling them with fairness, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Guide managers on performance concerns, conflict resolution, and disciplinary processes.

**Requirements**

* **Education:**
  MBA from a tier 1 institution. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HR teams. Experience across talent acquisition, HR operations, employee engagement, and employee relations is essential. Experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment is strongly preferred.
* **Strategic Leadership:**
  Proven experience as part of a senior leadership team, contributing to business strategy and cross-functional decisions beyond HR. Exposure to market entry, expansion, or new business initiative planning is strongly preferred.
* **Business Acumen:**
  Ability to connect people initiatives to revenue, growth, and operational outcomes, and to communicate people-related risks and opportunities in business terms.
* **Strategic Thinking:**
  Ability to build scalable HR processes and organizational structures for a growing, multi-market organization.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Hands-on experience with HRMS platforms such as KEKA is highly desirable.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication, with the confidence to influence and advise the CEO, board members, and senior leaders, as well as employees at every level.
* **Interpersonal Skills:**
  Approachable, empathetic, and trustworthy, with a genuine commitment to employee wellbeing and a positive workplace culture.
* **Leadership:**
  Proven ability to coach, develop, and motivate a team, and to make sound decisions with discretion and fairness.
* **Ownership:**
  A proactive, accountable approach, with the ability to set priorities, drive initiatives end to end, and operate with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer**

* **Executive Leadership Seat:**
  Report directly to the CEO and hold a seat at the leadership table, with a real voice in company strategy and major decisions.
* **Strategic Impact:**
  Shape the people function from the ground up and influence the direction of the company, including its expansion into new markets.
* **Competitive Compensation:**
  A leadership-level package that reflects your experience and the scope of the role.
* **Growth Opportunities:**
  Be part of a fast-growing organization with room to expand your scope as the business scales.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  Join a young, energetic team that values inclusivity, new ideas, and open communication.
* **Meaningful Work:**
  Play a central role in building an engaged, high-performing workplace where people can do their best work.

Puretech is a well-established integrated marketing communications group with 360 degree offerings spanning marketing analytics, brand strategy, social and digital media, influencer marketing, content, events and activation, media planning, and online response management.

The group has over 800 employees across multiple locations in the country, and three large offices in Mumbai, Delhi and Kolkata, plus a large team of work-from-home employees, and consultants, both in India and overseas.

**Group Transformation**

The Group is moving from a collection of three entrepreneurial businesses toward a more integrated, professionally managed entity with a common vision and values.

The transformation includes organisation redesign, leadership strengthening, integration of the three distinct entities with stronger performance management and the development of common systems, culture and governance across the Group.

The Group CHRO will therefore be a central architect of the transformation, helping the organisation attract and retain the requisite talent for the group’s ambitious plans over the next 3-5 years.

**Role Specifics**

This is a newly created Group CHRO mandate with responsibility for building the people, organisation and leadership architecture required as the Group scales through acquisitions, restructuring and international expansion. The role will report to one of the founders and will partner closely with group leadership, as well as have significant visibility to the Board and senior stakeholders.

This is not a conventional HR operations role, instead it is a strategic role that will enable the group to attain its growth ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Organisation Design, Group HR Processes, and Governance Systems***

* Design Group HR architecture with accountabilities across corporate, business and shared-service structures.
* Build scalable people processes and governance to ensure integration, speed of decision-making, and flexibility.
* Strengthen HR systems, people analytics, policies and governance appropriate for a growing multibusiness group.

***Leadership, Succession and Executive Hiring***

* Own senior leadership hiring across CEO, CXO, business-head and critical specialist positions.
* Build succession plans and a strong second line beneath current leaders
* Develop a rigorous assessment framework for senior talent, including leadership capability, culture fit and integration readiness.

***Transformation & Change Leadership***

* Lead the people agenda for the broader transformation programme.
* Design and execute change-management interventions across businesses, functions and geographies.
* Create a shared culture that balances entrepreneurial ownership with stronger governance, accountability and operating discipline.

***Performance, Rewards & Talent***

* Strengthen and integrate current performance management system
* Build leadership-development and high-potential programmes that strengthen retention and the Group succession bench.
* Ensure compensation and incentives are aligned to business performance.

**Desired candidate profile**

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, with substantial exposure to Group-level or multi-business environments.
* A track record of leading organisation transformation, professionalisation and change rather than operating primarily as a transactional HR leader.
* Strong experience in senior executive hiring, succession, leadership assessment and building high performing leadership teams.
* Experience working closely with founders, Chairmen, CEOs and Boards in businesses undergoing rapid growth or restructuring.
* Experience in a consumer-facing, services, media, technology, professional services or similarly entrepreneurial environment would be valuable.

**Profile & Leadership Style**

* Strategic and commercially minded HR leader with strong executive presence and judgement.
* Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders,maintaining trust and confidentiality.
* High energy and execution orientation, with the ability to move between strategy and detailed implementation.
* Strong interpersonal credibility, maturity and discretion in handling highly sensitive leadership matters.

**Education**

• MBA / postgraduate qualification in Human Resources

description:

Supporting the Student Opportunity service within the Directorate of Student Success & Educational Engagement, working closely with the client’s International Office and Acumen India in-Country representatives, you will help build strategic partnerships in India that enhance student and graduate employability.

Supporting Acumen in‑country representation mandate, you will act as a dedicated resource for employability and business development activities in India, helping build strategic partnerships with employers, industry bodies, higher and professional education partners, and India’s start‑up ecosystem. Alumni will be central to this work, acting as ambassadors, connectors, mentors, employers, and advocates. Operating at the intersection of higher education and labour markets, you will help convert employer insight and market intelligence into high‑impact opportunities. You will help champion a distinctive talent proposition, helping position the client’s graduates as globally experienced professionals.

A key priority of the role will be to explore and assess the potential phased development of client’s India Talent Hub, a flagship employability and talent partnership initiative in India. Bringing together employers, start‑ups, alumni, investors, industry, and the client, the postholder will investigate how the Hub could create exclusive internships, experiential learning, and graduate career and entrepreneurship opportunities through the client’s India Graduate Careers Advancement Programme.

We are looking for an experienced business development professional with a strong understanding of the Indian market. You will be commercially astute, highly collaborative, and confident operating independently and across organisational boundaries. With a proven ability to identify opportunities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment, you will bring energy, insight, and strategic focus to this role. The role requires regular travel across India and internationally, along with occasional evening and weekend working.

title: US Payroll - Team Lead
company: Laabdhi Outsource India Services Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED :**



5–8 years in US payroll

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are looking for an experienced Team Leader – US Payroll to independently own the payroll, HR-compliance and related back-office function for a multi-location US retail client. The role is the client's primary point of contact and works directly with the VP of Operations, district managers and store managers. The candidate must be able to run bi-weekly payroll in ADP Workforce Now end-to-end without supervision, take sound decisions on exceptions and abnormal situations, and set up the processes, checklists and controls needed to deliver accurately and on time. As the engagement grows, the role will also guide and review the work of junior team members.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Client Ownership & Leadership**

·        Act as the primary point of contact for the client; run regular calls with the VP of Operations and store/district managers, agree timelines and manage expectations.

·        Work independently on day-to-day matters and escalate only significant risks or policy decisions to the client and the Reporting Manager.

·        Build and maintain SOPs, payroll calendars, checklists and process documentation for the client.

·        Guide, train and review the work of junior team members as the scope grows; ensure maker–checker controls are followed.

·        Report status, issues and turnaround metrics to the Reporting Manager every week.

**2. Payroll Processing**

·        Own end-to-end bi-weekly payroll processing in ADP Workforce Now across all stores, including pay changes and bonuses, and review each run with the VP of Operations before finalisation.

·        Perform pre- and post-payroll reconciliations (hours, gross-to-net, variances against prior period, tax and deduction registers).

·        Ensure compliance with federal, state and local hourly wage requirements (minimum wage, overtime, break rules) across all store locations.

·        Set up and manage statutory and voluntary deductions such as child support orders, wage garnishments and tax levies.

**3. Exception & Abnormal-Situation Handling**

·        Resolve payroll exceptions independently: off-cycle and manual checks, missed or incorrect payments, retro pay, reversals, voids and adjustments.

·        Handle state and local tax notices, wage-and-hour queries and agency correspondence; investigate root cause and respond within deadlines.

·        Manage year-end and quarter-end activities with ADP (W-2 corrections, tax filing reconciliations, amendments).

·        Identify recurring errors, perform root-cause analysis and put corrective controls in place.

**4. Employee Onboarding**

·        Coordinate with store and district managers to onboard new hires; ensure Form I-9 verifications are complete and accurate and direct deposit details are uploaded in ADP.

·        Track onboarding status and keep managers updated on employees who have not yet completed the process.

·        Apply for local tax IDs as needed for new work locations and set them up in ADP, or coordinate with the client's executive administrator.

**5. Offboarding & Unemployment Claims Management**

·        Ensure termination dates and separation details are recorded accurately in ADP and final pay meets state timing rules.

·        Manage unemployment claims: gather facts from the relevant district manager (dates, reason for separation, documentation) and respond through the state portal.

·        Complete and submit fact-finding questionnaires and relief-from-charges forms accurately and within deadlines; prepare for appeals where required.

·        Maintain a claims tracker covering status and response deadlines so nothing is missed.

**6. Benefits Administration**

·        Administer the existing benefits program: enrollments, payroll deductions, COBRA notices and employee queries.

·        Send out annually required benefits notices and forms.

·        Monitor employee hours to identify newly ACA-eligible employees and send enrollment forms.

·        Prepare and file annual Forms 1094-C / 1095-C, or work with the VP of Operations to ensure timely and accurate filing.

·        Maintain compliance with applicable benefits regulations (ACA, COBRA, ERISA).

**7. Sales Tax Remittance**

·        Calculate and remit sales tax for each store on a monthly or quarterly basis as required by the state and local jurisdiction, and maintain a filing calendar.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

·        Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or HR (B.Com / M.Com / MBA preferred).

·        5–8 years of hands-on US payroll experience, including at least 2 years independently handling a US client or acting as team lead / senior.

·        Strong working experience with ADP Workforce Now (mandatory).

·        Sound knowledge of US payroll compliance: FLSA, federal/state/local withholding, multi-state taxation, garnishments, Form I-9, final-pay rules.

·        Practical experience with unemployment claims, benefits administration, COBRA and ACA (1094-C / 1095-C) reporting.

·        Exposure to US state sales tax filings.

·        Advanced MS Excel (XLOOKUP, pivot tables) for reconciliations, trackers and reporting.

**KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

·        Excellent written and spoken English; confident in direct communication with US managers and executives.

·        Independent judgment and problem-solving; able to handle escalations and unusual situations calmly.

·        High accuracy and strong control mindset when handling confidential employee data.

·        Deadline ownership across payroll, claims and filing calendars.

·        Ability to mentor, review and build a team.

·        Willingness to work US shift hours.

**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**

·        US payroll certification (APA FPC / CPP) or equivalent training.

·        Experience with US retail, restaurant or franchise businesses (multi-location hourly workforce).

·        Exposure to other payroll / HRIS platforms (Paychex, Gusto, UKG, QuickBooks Payroll).

description:

Taggd is a digital recruitment platform that provides Ready-to-Hire talent to India Inc. Combining human knowledge and data, we have fulfilled talent mandates for 100+ clients and ensured hiring manager success for half a million jobs across 14+ sectors. Our vision is to fulfil 1 million jobs through our talent platform by 2030.

**Role Snapshot**

* **Designation:**

  Senior Director – Talent Solutions

  1,000–1,500 hires annually across multiple business functions

  13+ years in recruitment or RPO, including 6–8 years leading a team

**About the Role**

Own the end-to-end talent acquisition mandate for an assigned manufacturing or automotive account. You will deliver the annual hiring plan to SLA, protect account revenue, and build a recruitment team that consistently meets its targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and Operations*

* Deliver the annual hiring plan of 1,000–1,500 hires, tracked as monthly fulfilment against plan (target: 95%+)
* Keep time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every requisition ageing beyond 30 days in the weekly account review
* Track funnel ratios weekly (CV-to-shortlist, shortlist-to-interview, interview-to-offer) and act on any stage below benchmark
* Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement
* Publish a weekly dashboard covering open positions, ageing, pipeline health, SLA status and offers in hand
* Own account revenue against the annual plan, including billing accuracy and on-time collections
* Ensure 100% ATS data accuracy with same-day candidate status updates

*Sourcing and Talent Pipeline*

* Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates and head-hunt for roles portals cannot fill
* Build ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles
* Introduce at least one new sourcing channel or campaign format each quarter and report its yield
* Complete skill and sub-skill mapping for 100% of active requisitions

*Client and Stakeholder Governance*

* Run weekly requisition reviews with hiring managers and monthly and quarterly business reviews with client leadership
* Act as the single point of contact for all recruitment, sourcing and escalation matters on the account
* Share market intelligence (talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement) in every monthly review
* Measure hiring manager CSAT each quarter and close every feedback item with a documented action

*Technology and AI Adoption*

* Drive full team adoption of AI-enabled tools for campaign creation, sourcing, screening and candidate engagement
* Ensure governance and compliance with zero audit exceptions on the account

*People Management*

* Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance through the year
* Share the quarterly scorecard with the Performance Management team on time
* Run structured engagement and team-bonding connects, and build a documented career path for each team member
* Plan and track training; hold voluntary attrition at or below 15%

**What We’re Looking For**

* 13+ years in recruitment or RPO delivery, of which 6–8 years leading a recruitment team through an annual hiring plan
* Volume hiring experience in manufacturing or automotive, with a clear view of where the talent sits, what it costs and why offers fall through (mandatory requirement)
* Ability to hold your own with business heads and CHRO-level stakeholders and challenge unrealistic briefs with data
* Hands-on sourcing skills: head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and professional networks
* Strong funnel analysis: spot a failing stage early, explain the cause and act on it
* Comfort with AI-enabled sourcing tools (CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated outreach) and measuring what each one yields
* Ability to run the weekly delivery dashboard and monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show
* Skill in building recruiter capability: identify gaps, coach and add capability where needed
* Ownership of the measures the client judges the account on: hiring plan fulfilment, TAT and SLA management
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred

**Job description:**

**Title: Senior HR Manager**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Experience: 6–8 Years**

**Industry Preference: D2C | Wellness | Beauty | Lifestyle | Nutrition | FMCG | Consumer Brands**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Role Overview:**

As the Senior HR Manager, you will be responsible for driving the complete HR function across the employee lifecycle — from workforce planning and hiring to performance management, employee engagement, culture, policies, compliance, and retention.

You will work closely with the founders and business leadership to build a scalable, high-performance organisation and ensure that HR evolves in line with the company’s growth.

The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader, business partner, problem solver, and culture builder who can operate independently and bring structure to a rapidly growing organisation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. HR Strategy & Business Partnering

\* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy aligned with Ace Blend’s business objectives and growth plans.

\* Partner closely with founders, leadership and functional heads on people-related decisions.

\* Translate business requirements into effective people strategies and processes.

\* Drive workforce planning, organisation design and manpower budgeting.

\* Identify organisational gaps and recommend solutions around people, structure and capability.

\* Build HR systems and processes that can scale with the organisation.

\* Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on employee, performance and organisational matters.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Own the end-to-end recruitment strategy across functions and levels.

\* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and define role expectations.

\* Build strong talent pipelines across business-critical functions.

\* Develop effective sourcing strategies through LinkedIn, referrals, agencies, networks and other channels.

\* Manage senior and niche hiring mandates independently.

\* Drive employer branding initiatives to strengthen Ace Blend’s talent proposition.

\* Track recruitment metrics including time-to-hire, quality of hire, offer-to-joining ratio and hiring costs.

\* Build a strong candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.

3. Performance Management

\* Own and strengthen the company’s performance management framework.

\* Drive goal-setting, KRAs/KPIs and performance review cycles.

\* Partner with managers to ensure effective performance conversations and feedback mechanisms.

\* Identify high performers, underperformers and critical talent.

\* Develop performance improvement plans wherever required.

\* Build a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous feedback.

\* Work with leadership on succession planning and talent development.

4. Employee Engagement & Culture

\* Build and strengthen Ace Blend’s culture as the organisation scales.

\* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives, events and internal communication.

\* Develop initiatives focused on employee experience, recognition and retention.

\* Conduct employee pulse checks and engagement surveys.

\* Identify employee concerns and proactively address them.

\* Create a positive, inclusive and high-performance work environment.

\* Strengthen internal communication between leadership and employees.

5. Learning & Development

\* Identify organisation-wide and function-specific learning requirements.

\* Build annual learning and development plans.

\* Work with external trainers, consultants and platforms wherever required.

\* Develop leadership and managerial capability within the organisation.

\* Create career development frameworks and growth paths for employees.

\* Promote continuous learning and upskilling.

6. HR Policies, Processes & Compliance

\* Build, review and implement HR policies and processes across the employee lifecycle.

\* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.

\* Own processes related to onboarding, probation, confirmation, transfers, promotions and exits.

\* Ensure effective implementation of POSH and other statutory policies.

\* Partner with external consultants/legal advisors wherever required.

\* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.

\* Continuously identify opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience.

7. HR Operations & HRMS

\* Oversee day-to-day HR operations and ensure smooth employee lifecycle management.

\* Manage and optimise HRMS, attendance, leave and payroll processes.

\* Work closely with finance/payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.

\* Ensure employee documentation and records are maintained accurately.

\* Build HR dashboards and reports for leadership.

\* Track key people metrics and provide actionable insights to management.

8. Employee Relations

\* Act as the primary point of escalation for employee-related matters.

\* Handle grievances, conflicts and disciplinary matters professionally.

\* Support managers in handling sensitive employee situations.

\* Ensure fair and consistent application of company policies.

\* Conduct exit interviews and identify trends impacting attrition and retention.

\* Develop initiatives to improve employee retention and overall experience.

9. Organisation Development

\* Support the organisation through periods of rapid growth and change.

\* Build scalable organisational structures, processes and people practices.

\* Identify capability gaps and recommend hiring/development interventions.

\* Support leadership in building high-performing teams.

\* Develop frameworks for career progression, succession planning and internal mobility.

\* Help create a strong leadership pipeline as the organisation expands.

10. HR Analytics & Reporting

\* Develop and maintain HR dashboards and monthly people reports.

\* Track metrics such as:

\* Headcount

\* Attrition

\* Hiring

\* Cost per hire

\* Time to hire

\* Employee engagement

\* Absenteeism

\* Performance

\* Retention

\* Present people insights and recommendations to leadership.

\* Use data to identify trends and support better people decisions.

**What We Are Looking For:**

\* 6–8 years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in a generalist/HRBP/people leadership capacity.

\* Prior experience in D2C, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, nutrition, FMCG, retail, consumer brands or startup environments is highly preferred.

\* Strong understanding of the complete employee lifecycle.

\* Experience working directly with founders, CXOs and senior leadership.

\* Proven experience in building HR processes in a growing organisation.

\* Strong experience in talent acquisition and stakeholder management.

\* Hands-on experience with performance management and employee engagement.

\* Good understanding of HR compliance and labour laws.

\* Strong communication, interpersonal and influencing skills.

\* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with maturity.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic and ambiguous environment.

\* High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently.

\* Strong business understanding and commercial orientation.

**Preferred Background:**

We would particularly value candidates who have worked with:

D2C Brands | Wellness | Nutrition | Beauty | Skincare | Personal Care | Lifestyle | FMCG | Retail | Consumer Tech | Premium Consumer Brands | High-Growth Startups

**4. Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Recruitment & Staffing**

• Manage end-to-end hiring for all cadres and critical roles.

• Develop manpower plans in collaboration with the business heads.

• Shortlist candidates, schedule interviews, conduct HR rounds and coordinate assessments.

• Maintain recruitment trackers, dashboards, and MIS.

• Design Learning & Development framework aligned with regulatory & organizational requirements.

• Maintain training MIS, feedback reports and training effectiveness documentation.

• Plan monthly/quarterly training calendars.

• Facilitate arrangements for training infrastructure for functional and induction programs.

• Coordinate with expert agencies, external organizations and external faculty for training delivery.

• Float training feedback forms in eHRMS and track responses.

**3. HR Operations & employee lifecycle management**

• Manage employee onboarding, documentation, joining formalities and induction process.

• Maintain employee files, HRMS data and assist in employee confirmations.

• Support leave & attendance, transfers, travel reimbursements and general HR administration.

• Assist in preparation of monthly HR dashboards and compliance reports.

• Handle settlement of HR-related bills, invoices and ensure timely processing of payments.

• Process and issue NOCs related to part-time studies, external exams, and interview permissions.

• Provide day-to-day support to Regional Offices for HR processes, queries and documentation.

**4. Employee Master Data & HRMS Management**

• Create employee master records in eHRMS for new joiners and deputed officials.

• Facilitate creation of login access for all new employees and deputed officials across applications.

• Update employee master data based on verified requests and documentation.

• Maintain confidential salary records and coordinate with Payroll teams as required.

• Assist in CTC modelling and compensation-related documentation.

• Assist in planning and organizing employee engagement events (e.g., marathons, cultural events).

• Organize welfare activities such as health camps, wellness programs and awareness sessions.

• Support grievance handling processes and employee communication drives.

• Coordinate with Regional Offices for cases where Regional Managers are the approving authorities.

• Ensure accurate and timely updates in HRMS and related systems for exit cases.

**9. Policy Development & Compliance**

title: Director of Human Resources
description:
**Director of Human Resources**

* **The opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo is the most recognised name in premium tattooing in India — a ₹45 Cr brand today, with a credible line of sight to ₹500 Cr by 2030, scaling from 14 studios toward 100 across India and select international markets, alongside a fast-growing tattoo school and a new home business.

A business doesn't scale 10X on strategy decks. It scales on people — the artists, managers and leaders we hire, grow, reward and keep. Today that engine is largely founder-built. We're looking for the person who takes it over and makes it world-class: the one who builds the hiring machine that brings in players better than us, the performance system that makes high performance the norm, and the org that's ready for 100 studios before we get there.

This is the most important builder hire we will make. We're looking for the person who owns it.

* **The mandate**

You will own the HR function end-to-end — people strategy, talent acquisition, performance management, total rewards, HR operations and culture — as a single accountable pillar of Aliens' growth. You report to the Founder, sit at the strategy table, and have the authority to build this properly.

This is a function to be built and sharpened, not inherited. We already have a serious performance architecture (APMS), a role and grading system (RDS / AGS) and a clear set of values — you will run them, improve them, and eventually re-architect them as you earn the right to. You will design the hiring engine, stand up a lean and correct HR-operations backbone, build the org and succession plans against the growth curve, and own the thinking so the Founder is progressively freed from running people decisions himself.

You will do this with a deliberately lean team. The right person multiplies through systems and a couple of sharp hires — not through headcount.

* **What you'll be doing**

Translating the business plan into a people strategy — the workforce, capability and org roadmap against 14→100 / ₹500 Cr — so we build the org ahead of growth, not scrambling behind it.

Building and personally running the A+ hiring engine — sourcing, assessing and closing — and stepping in yourself on the hardest, scarcest roles: studio managers, function heads, senior craft.

Running and sharpening the performance system — the monthly / quarterly / annual cadence, honest calibration and real differentiation across teams — so high performance is the standard and 'everyone exceeds' never takes hold.

Owning total rewards — pay philosophy, band ranges, the merit matrix and bonus formula, benefits and recognition — competitive enough to land A players, anchored to role worth, and compliant with Indian law.

Standing up the HR-operations backbone lean — HRIS, payroll, statutory compliance, the people-data layer and the SOPs — so the function runs clean and scales without a head for every hundred we hire.

Designing org structure and succession as we scale — calling the next layer before it's needed and making sure no critical seat is single-point-dependent.

Making the values operational across the lifecycle and protecting the high-performance-with-care line, so growth never quietly softens us into a comfort culture.

Building the lean team that does all of the above.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — built it, not just run it. You've stood up or rebuilt an HR function in a scaling business, ideally in services, retail, hospitality or another craft / people-heavy world, and you know what breaks at fifty studios that didn't break at fifteen.

You are a recruiter at heart. You've personally sourced and closed scarce, senior talent — not delegated it to a team — and you raise the bar rather than fill seats.

You've built performance and reward systems with teeth. Real calibration, a merit matrix, variable pay — not 'we rolled out a tool'. You can read our APMS, run it, and make it sharper.

You are strategic and hands-on in equal measure. You can lay out a three-year people plan at the strategy table, and you can personally fix a payroll mis-filing or close a hire the same week. Most senior HR leaders are good at one of these.

You build lean. You've run more with less, and you multiply through systems and a couple of sharp hires — not a growing org chart.

A genuine interest in our craft, our people and our brand is not a plus — it's table stakes.

* **What success looks like**

Here's the part most candidates get wrong, so we'll be direct about it. Plenty of senior HR people can run a function — chair the reviews, approve the policies, manage a team that does the work. Far fewer can build that engine from near-zero: design the philosophy, write the first SOP, make the first hard hire, architect the performance system — and know every nut and bolt deeply enough to then delegate it, automate it, and build the people who run it.

That depth is the point — not so you do everything yourself, but so you build it right and hand it off well. We're not looking for someone who hoards the work, and we're not looking for someone who floats above it and directs from a distance. We're looking for the rare person who can go deep enough to build the system, then lift good people to run it

We're hiring a builder who can think, not a strategist who can only direct.

And one line we won't compromise on: we are a high-performance company that genuinely loves its people — a championship team, not a family. The wrong hire reads 'protect the bar' and 'love people' as a contradiction and quietly optimises for comfort. The right one knows they're the same thing — and protects both as we scale.

title: Lead- HR Operations
description:
**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

Own the backbone of our people function: accurate payroll, compliant processes, streamline data and a smooth employee experience across a multi-country workforce. You will partner closely with Finance on budgets and payouts and bring automation and analytics to how we work. At Lead level, you will also own process and policy governance and guide junior team members.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

* **HR operations:**
  Own end-to-end operations from onboarding to exit (documentation, confirmations, transfers, letters, full-and-final settlements); run the HR Ops helpdesk within agreed SLAs; maintain accurate HRMS and offline data.
* **Global payroll:**
  Manage monthly payroll for ~300 employees across India, the Middle East and the USA with in-country partners; validate inputs, reconcile with Finance and ensure statutory deductions, filings and year-end processes for each location.
* **Compensation and benefits:**
  Support salary structures, annual increments, promotions and offer benchmarking; manage mediclaim, insurance and other benefits (renewals, enrolments, claims); review benefits against market practice and cost.
* **Performance and incentives:**
  Run the performance management cycle operationally; calculate and process variable pay, sales incentives and commission payouts with Finance sign-off.
* **HR budgeting (AOP):**
  Prepare and track the HR budget / Annual Operating Plan; work with Finance on provisioning, accruals, cost allocation and variance reporting.
* **Compliance and audit:**
  Ensure statutory and labour-law compliance across locations; manage internal and external audits (statutory, ISO/SOC, customer) through to closure.
* **Policy and process governance:**
  Draft, update and roll out HR policies and SOPs aligned with local laws; monitor adherence and drive continuous improvement.
* **HR analytics, MIS and automation:**
  Publish recurring HR MIS (headcount, attrition, payroll cost, leave etc.) and ad hoc reports for leadership; build dashboards; automate manual processes through the HRMS and workflow tools.
* **Employee relations and engagement:**
  Act as a trusted, confidential point of contact on employee concerns.
* **Vendor management:**
  Manage HR vendors (payroll partners, insurers, brokers, background verification, HRMS) including SLAs, invoices, renewals and reviews.
* **Projects:**
  Lead or contribute to HR operations projects such as system rollouts, new-country set-ups and process redesign.

**Skills & Experience that we value:**

**Must-haves**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree / diploma in Human Resource Management or equivalent.
* 4–6 years in HR operations, with hands-on payroll, benefits and compliance experience.
* Proven experience running payroll for ~300 employees across multiple global locations.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance; exposure to Middle East and US practices.
* Hands-on HRMS experience (e.g. Darwinbox) and advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations).
* Experience working with Finance on budgets, accruals and incentive payouts.

**Good-to-haves**

* Experience in a product, SaaS or technology company.
* Exposure to ISO / SOC 2 or customer-led audits.
* Automation or analytics skills (Power BI, workflow tools, macros).
* For Lead level: experience mentoring team members and owning a process area end to end.

**Competencies**

* Accurate, organised and deadline-driven; handles confidential pay and employee data with integrity and discretion.
* Analytical, customer-oriented and a clear communicator with employees, leaders and vendors.
* Self-driven and resilient under pressure; strong in Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with AI tools knowledge (e.g. Claude, Glean) a plus.

**Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together.**

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Position Purpose**

The Head HR will be responsible for developing and executing the people strategy that enables Companies India & Global growth ambitions while fostering a high-performance, employee-centric, safety-first culture.

The role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and leadership team on organization design, talent acquisition, leadership development, employee engagement, industrial relations, performance management, rewards, succession planning, culture transformation, and workforce productivity across corporate, manufacturing, projects, service, and O&M operations.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in positioning company as an employer of choice within the renewable energy industry while ensuring strong governance, compliance, and workforce capability to support long-term business success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic HR Leadership**

* Develop and implement an HR strategy aligned with Companies business objectives and growth plans.
* Partner with the CEO and leadership team on organizational effectiveness and workforce planning.
* Drive culture initiatives focused on accountability, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and customer orientation.
* Lead organizational transformation and change management programs.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Develop robust manpower plans to support manufacturing expansion, project execution, service growth, and new business initiatives.
* Build strong recruitment pipelines for leadership, engineering, manufacturing, project execution, sales, and service functions.
* Strengthen employer brand in the renewable energy sector.
* Reduce time-to-hire while improving quality of hires and retention.

**Leadership Development & Succession Planning**

* Establish leadership development frameworks for future business leaders.
* Build succession plans for all critical positions.
* Design career progression and talent acceleration programs.
* Drive coaching and mentoring initiatives across the organization.

**Performance & Productivity Management**

* Lead performance management processes across the organization.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and individual KPIs.
* Introduce data-driven productivity and performance measurement systems.
* Drive continuous improvement and accountability culture.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Enhance employee satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Lead employee listening forums, surveys, and engagement initiatives.
* Promote a culture where employees feel respected, valued, and empowered.
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being initiatives.

**Compensation, Benefits & Rewards**

* Design and implement competitive compensation and rewards programs.
* Conduct benchmarking against leading renewable energy, engineering, and manufacturing companies.
* Develop retention and recognition programs for high-potential employees.
* Support merit reviews and incentive plans linked to business performance.

**Industrial Relations & Employee Relations**

* Maintain harmonious industrial relations across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure proactive engagement with employees and stakeholders.
* Drive grievance handling and conflict resolution mechanisms.
* Support business continuity through effective workforce relations.

**Learning & Capability Building**

* Establish technical and leadership competency frameworks.
* Drive capability development programs across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, project execution, EHS, and O&M.
* Ensure training programs align with future business requirements.
* Create a learning culture focused on continuous development.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Lead POSH, ethics, disciplinary, and employee governance processes.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain robust HR policies, procedures, and controls.

**HR Digitization & Analytics**

* Drive digital HR transformation initiatives.
* Develop leadership dashboards for workforce analytics.
* Establish data-driven decision-making through HR metrics and insights.
* Improve HR process effectiveness and employee experience through automation.

**Education**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* Additional qualifications in Labour Law, Organization Development, Coaching, Industrial Relations, or Compensation Management preferred.

**Experience**

• 18+ years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience, with a strong track record of driving organizational effectiveness and people strategy.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior HR leadership role with enterprise-wide responsibility for talent, culture, organizational development, employee relations, and workforce planning.

• Demonstrated success in leading organizational growth, transformation, change management, and culture-building initiatives.

• Proven experience managing large and geographically dispersed workforces across multiple business functions and locations.

• Strong expertise in leadership development, succession planning, talent management, performance management, and employee engagement.

• Exposure to complex, multi-site, project-driven, manufacturing, engineering, or service organizations is advantageous but not mandatory.

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:
  
  

* Accounting & Finance
* Culinary
* Engineering
* Event Operations
* Event Planning
* Food & Beverage Operations
* Human Resources
* Revenue Management
* Rooms Operations
* Sales & Marketing
* Information Technology
* Residences

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.
  
  
**The Experience You’ll Gain**
Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:
  
  

* Cultivate customer relationships
* Be a champion for innovation within the organization
* Get exposure to managing projects & people
* Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
* Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

**Destination: Marriott leadership**
You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.
  
  
**Ready to embark?**
To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated from a university or hotel school within the past year. Other qualifications include:
  
  

* Bachelors degree or equivalent higher level education required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary)
* Superior critical thinking & interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
* Self-manage & be a self-starter
* Real desire for personal & professional growth
* Work authorization in the country you apply (local citizen or permanent resident)

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
We are hiring Recruitment Specialist in RPO setup. The candidate will be deployed at cliental site taking care of end-to-end recruitment. Below is the JD for your reference.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. 360-Degree End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and joining follow-ups.
* Conduct detailed requirement briefing discussions with hiring managers to understand job specifications, competencies, and business expectations.
* Source relevant profiles through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal databases, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen and assess candidates based on role requirements, experience, skills, compensation, and cultural fit.
* Maintain a healthy candidate pipeline and ensure timely submission of quality profiles.
* Drive interview scheduling, feedback collection, offer management, and candidate engagement throughout the hiring process.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure offer acceptance and successful joining.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while meeting defined recruitment SLAs and turnaround times.

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned hiring stakeholders and maintain effective working relationships.
* Proactively communicate recruitment progress, challenges, pipeline status, and anticipated delays.
* Drive timely interview feedback and decision-making from hiring managers.
* Understand changing business priorities and realign recruitment efforts accordingly.
* Manage stakeholder expectations regarding candidate availability, compensation benchmarks, and market realities.
* Identify potential hiring bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.
* Ensure a professional and seamless experience for both clients and candidates.

**3. Recruitment MIS and Excel Management**

* Maintain recruitment trackers with
  **100% accuracy and real-time updates**
  on candidate and position status.
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment MIS reports and dashboards.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including open positions, profiles sourced, submissions, interviews, offers, closures, joining ratios, and position ageing.
* Monitor individual productivity, recruitment funnel movement, and progress against assigned targets.
* Use MS Excel to analyse recruitment data, identify gaps, and generate actionable insights.
* Ensure data integrity, timely reporting, and adherence to client-specific reporting formats and processes.

**4. Recruitment Delivery and Process Compliance**

* Ensure recruitment delivery is aligned with agreed SLAs, client expectations, and quality benchmarks.
* Regularly review open positions and prioritise requirements based on business criticality.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and recruitment trackers.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment processes, documentation requirements, and client-specific guidelines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, turnaround time, and recruitment productivity.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience in 360-degree end-to-end recruitment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, client communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel, including
  **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, filters, sorting, and data management**
  .
* Experience in recruitment MIS, dashboards, and tracker management.
* Proficiency in sourcing through job portals, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, and databases.
* Strong candidate assessment, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with ATS and recruitment management systems.

**Educational Qualification and Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
* 3–6 years of relevant recruitment experience, preferably in an RPO or client-facing recruitment environment.
* Demonstrated experience in managing the complete recruitment lifecycle independently.
* Prior experience handling client stakeholders and recruitment MIS is essential.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of assigned hiring targets and recruitment SLAs.
* Quality and relevance of candidate submissions.
* Time-to-fill and position closure rate.
* Offer-to-join ratio and candidate engagement.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely feedback management.
* Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment trackers and MIS reports.
* Individual recruiter productivity and process compliance.

 Krushit Vanzara Studios is a creative post\-production studio specializing in Photo Retouching, Video Editing, Motion Graphics, and Graphic design, serving clients worldwide. Our team is a mix of detail\-obsessed editors and storytelling\-driven creatives who take their craft seriously.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for an HR professional who can take full ownership of the function, strengthen our systems, refine our processes, and shape how our team experiences working here. You'll report directly to leadership and have real influence over how the studio grows, in headcount and in culture.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* **Talent Acquisition:** 
 Strengthen our hiring pipeline and own the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing to onboarding.
* **HR Systems \& Compliance:** 
 Manage our HRMS, POSH compliance, payroll inputs, PT deductions, leave balances, and reimbursements in coordination with accounts. Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws (PF, ESIC, Gratuity Act, and more).
* **Policies \& Documentation:** 
 Maintain and improve our employee handbook, HR policies, and related documents.
* **People Operations:** 
 Handle onboarding, leave management, grievances, and performance review cycles. Be the first point of contact when people need support.
* **Culture \& Engagement:** 
 Protect and build on what makes KVS a great place to work through team events, Fun Fridays, celebrations, and engagement initiatives.
* **HR Reporting:** 
 Share regular reports with leadership on hiring, compliance, and team metrics.
* **Studio Culture Content:** 
 Work with the creative team to capture and share KVS culture on our social channels.
* **Office Administration:** 
 Oversee day\-to\-day office management, vendor coordination, and facilities.
* **Future Growth:** 
 As KVS expands, including an upcoming new studio, your scope will grow with it.



  





**Who You Are** 



* **3–6 years of HR experience** 
 , with exposure to both generalist and strategic responsibilities
* Mandatory minimum 6 months of experience working in a creative media company or an agency.
* You've handled recruitment, payroll coordination, and compliance, not just one of these
* Solid working knowledge of Indian labour law: PF, ESIC, PT and Gratuity Act
* Familiar with HRMS tools and comfortable setting one up from scratch
* Comfortable working independently and making decisions without a playbook
* Empathetic with people, firm with process; you know when to be which



  





 This role suits someone who has worked in a structured environment and is ready to take full ownership — or someone who has built an HR function before and wants to do it even better.
 



  





**What You Get** 



* **Performance Bonus**
* **20 Paid Days Off** 
 — 10 PTO / Casual / Sick Leave \+ 10 Festival \& Government Holidays
* **Gratuity** 
 as per statute
* **Travel Reimbursement**
* **Half\-day off on your birthday**
* **Work hours: 9 Hour Shift \| Alternate Saturdays operational**
* **Direct access to leadership and genuine decision\-making authority**



  





**Investment Range** 




**₹5 to 8 LPA** 




  





 📍 Andheri East, Mumbai — Work From Office (Mandatory)
 



  





 📩
 **To Apply:** 
 Send your CV and a brief note on your HR experience to hr@krushitvanzara.com
 



  





 We're not looking for someone to manage paperwork. We're looking for someone who sees HR as a craft, the way our editors see their work. If that resonates with you, we'd love to talk.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Title: HR \& Admin Manager** 




**Organization:** 
 STEM Shiksha Foundation, a not for profit sec 8 company
 



**Location:** 
 Officebing, Vikhroli West, Mumbai
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Operations
 



  





**About Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF)** 




 Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF) is a non\-profit organization transforming engineering education across India by shifting learning from theoretical instruction to hands\-on, active problem\-solving. Founded by visionary tech alumni, entrepreneurs, and academicians, MBF equips academic institutions with the tools, funding, and expertise needed to cultivate future\-ready innovators and engineers. Through its flagship Tinkerers' Labs (24/7 student\-led makerspaces), MBF gives students direct access to rapid prototyping technology. Its high\-impact initiatives, such as the InventX summer invention internship, the Vishwakarma Awards, and the Center for Essential Skills, foster both technical ingenuity and professional readiness. Collaborating directly with governing bodies like AICTE on Project PRACTICE, MBF works to integrate project\-based learning into Tier\-II and Tier\-III colleges. Driven by a vision to embed a vibrant maker culture into higher education, Maker Bhavan Foundation aims to expand to 100s of engineering colleges by 2030, directly empowering 10% of India's graduating engineers each year to translate bold ideas into real\-world technological solutions.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview** 




 STEM Shiksha Foundation is seeking a highly organized and proactive
 **HR \& Admin Manager** 
 to manage our day\-to\-day office operations and internal people processes.
 



 This is an execution\-heavy role for someone who enjoys building order out of chaos. You will be the backbone of the office—ensuring our physical and digital workspaces run like clockwork while managing the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our growing team. We need a "doer" who is comfortable switching between vendor negotiations and recruitment screenings with ease.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Office Administration \& Digital Systems (70%)** 



* **Daily Operations:** 
 Oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of our office at Vikhroli; manage housekeeping, supplies, and general upkeep.
* **Digital Architecture:** 
 Act as the primary administrator for
 **Google Workspace** 
 . This includes managing user access, structuring shared drives, and ensuring a clean, intuitive file\-naming hierarchy.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Source, negotiate with, and manage vendors for office utilities, stationery, and equipment.
* **Logistics Support:** 
 Coordinate travel, local transport, and scheduling for the leadership team and visiting stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** 
 Maintain rigorous digital and physical filing systems to ensure "audit\-ready" documentation at all times.



  





**B. HR Operations(30%)** 



* **Talent Acquisition:** 
 Manage the full recruitment funnel—posting jobs, initial resume screening, scheduling interviews, and maintaining a candidate database.
* **Onboarding \& Exits:** 
 Ensure every new hire has a seamless Day 1 (IT setup, documentation, orientation) and manage professional offboarding for exiting employees.
* **Policy Implementation:** 
 Roll out HR policies and ensure consistent adherence across the team.
* **Performance Support:** 
 Assist the Head of Operations in tracking KRAs and ensuring timely completion of performance review cycles.
* **Compliance:** 
 Maintain employee records, attendance, and basic HR compliance requirements.



  





**3\. Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–6 years of relevant HR \& Admin experience.
* Experience independently handling recruitment and HR operations.
* Prior experience in a startup, NGO, or small\-to\-mid\-sized education firm is highly preferred.



**Competencies** 



* **Execution Powerhouse:** 
 You don't just design processes; you enjoy the hands\-on work of implementing them.
* **Digital Fluency:** 
 Expert\-level command over Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar). You should be the person others ask for help with digital tools.
* **Organizational Hygiene:** 
 A natural knack for organizing files, schedules, and physical spaces.
* **Discretion:** 
 High integrity and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive employee information.



  





**Compensation** 




 Compensation will be competitive and based on experience and capability.

description:
**Job Description – India \& AMET Rewards Lead**
**Job title:** 
 India \& AMET Rewards Lead
   

  

* Grade: L3\-2
* Hiring Manager: AMEA Rewards Head
* Location: Mumbai, India
* % Remote working and % of travel expected: Hybrid
* Job type: Permanent, Full time


**Our Team**
 The AMEA (Africa, Middle East and Asia) Rewards \& Performance team at OPELLA is composed of motivated, energetic, and collaborative seasoned compensation and benefits professionals reporting to the AMEA Rewards and Performance Head, within the OPELLA Global Rewards \& Performance Team.
   

  

 The Global Rewards \& Performance team at OPELLA is organized in regional and subject matter expertise sub\-teams, with the common objective to improve the business' ability to attract, retain, and motivate top talent by developing and operating compensation and benefits policies and practices.
   

  

 This India \& AMET (Africa, Middle east and Turkey) Rewards Lead is a senior, strategic position based in Mumbai, designed to address the growing complexity and ambition of the rewards agenda across India and the AMET region (Including Tunisia, Egypt, Turkey, KSA and UAE countries). The role holder will act as the senior rewards partner for India — working in close collaboration with the India P\&C Director and the India Leadership Team — while simultaneously providing regional rewards leadership across AMET countries. This role drives also the transformational projects shaping the future of rewards at OPELLA India, and operates at the intersection of strategic advisory, transformation leadership, and operational excellence across a broad and diverse geography.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 This position plays a pivotal role in leading and elevating the OPELLA Rewards strategy across India and the AMET region, with a particular focus on driving transformational change initiatives, ensuring regulatory compliance as a listed entity, and providing senior\-level strategic guidance to the India P\&C Director, Leadership Team, and AMET business and HR leaders.
   

  

* Rewards and Performance Leadership for India \& AMET


 Oversee and drive operational excellence across all rewards and performance activities for India \& AMET, including:
   

  

* Shape and define the comprehensive Rewards strategy for India and AMET in alignment with the business strategy established by leadership, HR strategy and priorities defined in partnership with P\&C and market benchmarking analysis.
* Market Competitiveness \& Analytics: Lead the monitoring of pay competitiveness in the India \& AMET market, oversee benchmarking analyses, and manage annual survey submissions and results interpretation. Provide data\-driven insights through dashboards and reporting tools to support leadership decision\-making.
* Governance \& Compliance: Define and maintain effective governance with GBS, Finance, and P\&C Partners for all compensation and benefits activities in India \& AMET, within the framework of the OPELLA Global R\&P governance. Ensure full compliance with India \& AMET\-specific remuneration regulations, taxation requirements, and listed entity obligations.
* Strategic Advisory \& Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a trusted senior advisor and compensation subject matter expert for the India \& AMET P\&C Director, Leadership Team, and HRBPs on all rewards\-related matters, including market trends, regulatory changes, and competitive positioning.
* Job Evaluation \& Offer Management: Lead job evaluations using the internal global grading framework and review and validate non\-standard offers in line with OPELLA governance frameworks.
* Annual Compensation Planning: Drive the annual compensation planning process for India \& AMET in close collaboration with P\&C and GBS, ensuring timely, accurate, and strategically aligned execution.
* NRC Support: Act as the local rewards point of contact for the India NRC (Nomination and Remuneration Committee), leading the preparation of materials, data, and analyses related to Independent Directors' remuneration and executive compensation
* Benefits \& Mobility Services: Oversee the smooth operation of OPELLA Benefits and International Mobility R\&P services offered in India \& AMET.
* Lead the transformational projects in India
* Rewards of the "Change the Game" India Strategy: Serve as the primary rewards driver for the "Change the Game" strategy in India, ensuring rewards frameworks and practices are aligned with and actively enabling the broader business transformation agenda.
* Lead the Rewards Side of the COE Transformation Project in India : Drive the strategic leadership of rewards aspects within the comprehensive COE (Center of Excellence) transformation initiative, ensuring successful implementation of a global COE model in India.


**Experience**
 About You
   

  

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Compensation \& Benefits / Total Rewards, with a strong and demonstrated focus on India \& AMET rewards, including deep knowledge of India \& AMETn compensation structures, salary components, benefits design, and regulatory requirements — this is a critical requirement for this role.
* Proven experience with the AMET region or other emerging markets in Asia, Middle East, or Africa, with demonstrated ability to navigate diverse regulatory and cultural environments.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale, transformational rewards projects from design through deployment, ideally including salary structure redesign and/or flexible benefits programs.
* Experience working within or supporting a listed entity in India \& AMET, with knowledge of NRC processes, SEBI regulations, and corporate governance requirements related to executive and director remuneration.
* Experience operating in a matrix organization and partnering with senior P\&C, Finance, and business leadership stakeholders at a regional or global level.
* Experience in pharma, life sciences, or consumer goods industry is a strong plus.


**Education**
* University degree or equivalent required; Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field is strongly preferred.
